cues: Counting isomers is a quick exam point.
Chlorobenzene itself has only one form.
Swap one chlorine for bromine, and C six H four C l B r again has three isomers, ortho, meta and para.
With three identical chlorines there are also three: one two three, one two four, and the symmetrical one three five.
